answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identity to a cryptographic stake burning curve where verification cost scales superlinearly: C(k) = B * k^2. An attacker attempting to flood the ledger drops off a financial ledge as costs explode exponentially per replica. Malicious nodes crash into this economic reef, while staking burns tokens permanently, stamping a verifiable pigment on authentic agents that adversaries cannot afford to forge.
